hypotheses.S1_strict_core_captures_half_of_bank_eff: The variable-size strict recurrent core retains at least half of the rank-256 magnitude-bank downstream fidelity in every layer and corpus.
hypotheses.S2_recurrence_beats_equal_size_magnitude: The strict recurrent core exceeds an equal-size mean-magnitude bank by at least 0.03 downstream fidelity in every layer and corpus.
hypotheses.S3_strict_core_has_positive_ood_effect: Strict recurrent-core median downstream fidelity is at least 0.05 on TinyStories at both layers.
hypotheses.S4_layer1_strict_core_is_stronger: Layer-1 strict-core fidelity exceeds Layer 0 by at least 0.03 on both corpora.
hypotheses.S5_strict_core_is_small: The median strict recurrent core contains at most 96 native channels at both layers.
